source: Supabase unified edge_logs, read-only connector query
sql: select log_attributes['request.path'] as rpc_path,log_attributes['response.status_code'] as status,count() as requests,uniqExact(log_attributes['request_id']) as distinct_request_ids from logs where source='edge_logs' and log_attributes['request.path'] in ('/rest/v1/rpc/apply_conference_mutation','/rest/v1/rpc/submit_resolution') group by rpc_path,status order by rpc_path,status
limitations: Earlier 2027 figure superseded; its original query/filter is not established
One staff request ID appears twice; cause not established
Runner samples have no per-request identifiers; unique server-call correspondence not proven
